path_redaction_note: Machine-specific paths have been sanitized: checkout paths are repo-relative; /example/artifacts/location-N and /example/toolchain are fictional locations scoped to this record. Measurements, revisions, and recorded hashes are unchanged.
baseline_changes: Only identical examples/cursor_traversal.rs and examples/cursor_traversal/fixture.rs copied into an isolated archive and built with its own target directory.
updated_engine: Working-tree incremental single Rust trail cursor projections with guarded SKIP, shared budgets and batched hydration
method: Three sequential fresh-process trials per engine, depth and consumption mode; release builds. Engine order alternates and mode order rotates between trials. All builds/tests finished before measurements. Each process builds a fresh in-memory graph. Query timing includes planning, snapshot setup, decoding, validation and cleanup, excludes fixture setup. First-row latency is time until the first owned row reaches the consumer. Peak RSS and elapsed wall time cover the entire child process, including graph setup. Quick smoke measurements excluded.
fixture: A chain with two parallel NEXT relationships per hop. Depth 10: 11 nodes/20 edges, 2046 paths. Depth 14: 15 nodes/28 edges, 32766 paths. Query returns length(p) and endpoint ID; full consumption verifies exact per-depth multiplicity 2^d; first mode verifies one one-hop result. Options allow 1000000 explored states and 1 GiB cumulative payload, retaining the default memory limit. Eligible edge inputs still load eagerly.
